items.title: Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord
items.desc: After the Clone Wars, Maul plots to rebuild his criminal syndicate on a planet untouched by the Empire.

items.title: Family Guy
items.desc: In a wacky Rhode Island town, a dysfunctional family strive to cope with everyday life as they are thrown from one crazy scenario to another.

items.title: Invincible
items.desc: Mark Grayson is a normal teenager except for the fact that his father is the most powerful superhero on the planet. Shortly after his seventeenth birthday, Mark begins to develop powers of his own and enters into his father’s tutelage.

items.title: American Dad
items.desc: The random escapades of Stan Smith, an extreme right wing CIA agent dealing with family life and keeping America safe, all in the most absurdist way possible.

items.title: The Simpsons
items.desc: The satiric adventures of a working class family in the misfit city of Springfield.

items.title: Avatar - The Last Airbender 2005
items.translated_genres: Animacja, Akcja, Przygodowy, Familijny, Fantasy, Detektywistyczny
items.desc: In a war-torn world of elemental magic, a young boy reawakens to undertake a dangerous mystic quest to fulfill his destiny as the Avatar.

items.title: Bob's Burgers
items.desc: Bob's Burgers centers on the Belcher family (consists of Bob, Linda, Tina, Gene and Louise) who own a hamburger restaurant...

items.title: South Park
items.desc: Follows the misadventures of four irreverent grade-schoolers in the quiet, dysfunctional town of South Park, Colorado.

items.title: Bluey
items.desc: Bluey is an inexhaustible six year-old Blue Heeler dog, who loves to play and turns everyday family life into extraordinary adventures, developing her imagination as well as her mental, physical and emotional resilience.

items.title: Rick and Morty
items.desc: An animated series that follows the exploits of a super scientist and his not so bright grandson.

items.title: Gravity Falls
items.desc: Dipper and Mabel Pines spend the summer at their great uncle's tourist trap, The Mystery Shack. They think it's just going to be another usual summer, until mysterious things begin occurring all over town.

items.title: Peppa Pig
items.desc: Peppa is a loveable, cheeky little piggy who lives with her little brother George, Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig...

items.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
items.desc: The misadventures of a fast-food restaurant working sponge who lives under the sea.

items.title: The Legend of Korra
items.translated_genres: Animacja, Akcja, Przygodowy, Dramat, Familijny, Fantasy
items.desc: Avatar Korra fights to keep Republic City safe from the evil forces of both the physical and spiritual worlds.

items.title: Star Wars: The Clone Wars
items.desc: Yoda, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Anakin Skywalker, Mace Windu and other Jedi Knights lead the Grand Army of the Republic against the droid army of the Separatists.

items.title: PAW Patrol
items.translated_genres: Animacja, Akcja, Przygodowy, Komedia, Familijny, Sportowy
items.desc: Ryder leads a team of rescue pups (Marshall, Rubble, Chase, Rocky, Zuma and Skye) who save their town from everyday emergencies, whether it's finding missing elephants, fixing windmills or another minor mishap involving clumsy Cap'n Turbot.

items.title: Futurama
items.desc: Fry, a pizza guy is accidentally frozen in 1999 and thawed out New Year's Eve 2999.

items.title: Adventure Time
items.desc: A human boy named Finn and his best friend Jake, a magical, talking dog, set out on their adventures in the magical Land of Ooo.

items.title: BoJack Horseman
items.desc: Meet the most beloved sitcom horse of the '90s - 20 years later. BoJack Horseman was the star of the hit TV show "Horsin' Around," but today he's washed up, living in Hollywood, complaining about everything, and wearing colorful sweaters.

items.title: Smiling Friends
items.desc: Smiling Friends Inc. is a small company whose main purpose is to bring happiness and make people smile. The series follows the day-to-day lives and misadventures of its representatives, the lazy, cynical Charlie, and the cheerful, optimistic Pim, as they try to cheer up and comfort the troubled people who call their company's hotline. They receive seemingly simple requests but the jobs turn out to be more complicated than they seem, making it difficult to bring happiness to the world.

items.title: Arcane
items.desc: Amid the stark discord of twin cities Piltover and Zaun, two sisters fight on rival sides of a war between magic technologies and clashing convictions.

items.title: We bare bears
items.desc: Three bear brothers do whatever they can to be a part of human society by doing what everyone around them does.

items.title: King of the Hill
items.desc: Set in Texas, this animated series follows the life of propane salesman Hank Hill, who lives with his overly confident substitute Spanish teacher wife Peggy, wannabe comedian son Bobby, and naive niece Luanne. Hank has conservative views about God, family, and country, but his values and ethics are often challenged by the situations he, his family, and his beer-drinking neighbors/buddies find themselves in.

items.title: Kevin
items.desc: A life-long housecat decides that he doesn’t want to live with people anymore. Loosely inspired by a real break-up and the cat caught in the middle, Kevin dares to ask himself, "Is there a world where I don’t do the owner thing and am just… single for the rest of my life?"

items.title: Tom and Jerry
items.desc: A weekly Saturday (later Sunday) Morning repackaged compilation with new wraparounds featuring two Tom and Jerry cartoons sandwiching other MGM animated theatrical shorts.

items.title: Love, Death and Robots
items.desc: Terrifying creatures, wicked surprises and dark comedy converge in this NSFW anthology of animated stories presented by Tim Miller and David Fincher.

items.title: Gabby's Dollhouse
items.desc: This colorful series leads preschoolers room to room through a fantastical dollhouse of delightful mini-worlds and irresistible kitty characters.

items.title: Marvels Spidey and His Amazing Friends
items.desc: Follow Peter Parker, Gwen Stacy and Miles Morales and their adventures as the young heroes team up with Hulk, Ms. Marvel and Black Panther to defeat foes like Rhino, Doc Ock and Green Goblin and learn that teamwork is the best way to save the day.

items.title: Steven Universe
items.desc: A young boy takes his mother's place in a group of gemstone-based beings, and must learn to control his powers.

items.title: My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic
items.desc: In the land of Equestria, Princess Celestia's apprentice Twilight Sparkle is sent to Ponyville to learn about the importance of friendship.

items.title: The Legend of Vox Machina
items.desc: They're rowdy, they're ragtag, they're misfits turned mercenaries for hire. Vox Machina is more interested in easy money and cheap ale than actually protecting the realm. But when the kingdom is threatened by evil, this boisterous crew realizes that they are the only ones capable of restoring justice.

items.title: Primal
items.desc: Primal features a caveman at the dawn of evolution. A dinosaur on the brink of extinction. Bonded by tragedy, this unlikely friendship becomes the only hope of survival in a violent, primordial world.

items.title: Regular Show
items.desc: The daily surreal adventures of a blue jay and raccoon duo that attempt to deal with their mundane jobs as groundskeepers at the local park.

items.title: Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi
items.desc: Journey into the lives of two distinctly different Jedi from the prequel era – Ahsoka Tano and Count Dooku. Each will be put to the test as they make choices that will define their destinies.

items.title: Solar Opposites
items.desc: A family of aliens from a much better world must take refuge in middle America after the destruction of their planet. Their mission: protect the Pupa, a living super computer that will one day evolve into its true form, consume them and terraform the Earth.

items.title: Krapopolis
items.desc: In mythical ancient Greece, a flawed family of humans, gods and monsters tries to run one of the world’s first cities without killing each other.

items.title: Star Wars: Rebels
items.desc: Set between the events of Star Wars: Episodes III and IV, the story unfolds during a dark time when the evil Galactic Empire is tightening its grip of power on the galaxy. Imperial forces have occupied a remote planet and are ruining the lives of its people. The motley but clever crew of the starship Ghost — cowboy Jedi Kanan, ace pilot Hera, street-smart teenager Ezra, the “muscle” Zeb, warrior firebrand Sabine, and cantankerous old astromech droid Chopper — is among a select few who are brave enough to stand against the Empire. Together, they will face threatening new villains, encounter colorful adversaries, embark on thrilling adventures, and become heroes with the power to ignite a rebellion.

items.title: Pantheon
items.desc: A bullied teen receives mysterious help from someone online: a stranger soon revealed to be her recently deceased father, David, whose consciousness has been uploaded to the Cloud following an experimental destructive brain scan. David is the first of a new kind of being – an “Uploaded Intelligence” or “UI” – but he will not be the last, as a global conspiracy unfolds that threatens to trigger a new kind of world war.

items.title: The Owl House
items.translated_genres: Komedia, Fantastyczny, Fantasy, Animacja, Akcja, Przygodowy
items.desc: Luz, a self-assured teenage human girl, accidentally stumbles upon a portal to the Demon Realm.

items.title: Scavengers Reign
items.desc: When a deep space freighter is damaged by a solar flare its surviving crew are stranded on a beautiful and unforgiving planet. They begin to learn the true nature of this planet as they try to survive long enough to escape or be rescued.

items.title: Star Wars: Tales of the Empire
items.desc: A journey into the fearsome Galactic Empire through the eyes of two warriors on divergent paths.

items.title: Hazbin Hotel
items.desc: In attempt to find a non-violent alternative for reducing Hell's overpopulation, the daughter of Lucifer opens a rehabilitation hotel that offers a group of misfit demons a chance at redemption.

items.title: The Mighty Nein
items.desc: When a powerful arcane relic known as 'The Beacon' falls into nefarious hands, a group of fugitives and outcasts, bound by secrets and scars, must learn to work together to save the realm and stop reality as they know it from unraveling.

items.title: Blue Eye Samurai
items.desc: Driven by a dream of revenge against those who made her an outcast in Edo-period Japan, a young warrior cuts a bloody path toward her destiny.

items.title: Stillwater
items.desc: Siblings Karl, Addy and Michael have a very special next-door neighbor: a wise panda named Stillwater. His friendship and stories give them new perspectives on the world, themselves, and each other.

items.title: Disenchantment 2018
items.desc: Set in a ruined medieval city called Dreamland, Disenchantment follows the grubby adventures of a hard-drinking princess, her feisty elf companion and her personal demon.

items.title: Over the Garden Wall
items.translated_genres: Animacja, Przygodowy, Komedia, Dramat, Familijny, Fantasy, Horror, Muzyczny, Detektywistyczny
items.desc: Two brothers find themselves lost in a mysterious land and try to find their way home.

items.title: X-Men
items.translated_genres: Familijny, Fantastyczny, Fantasy, Animacja, Akcja, Przygodowy
items.desc: The X-Men are an elite team of mutants, genetically gifted human beings with superpowers, sworn to fight for mutant rights against hostile Government agencies, whilst at the same time protecting mankind from mutant supremacist Magneto who seeks to destroy the human race in return for the atrocities committed against mutant kind.

items.title: Archer
items.desc: At ISIS, an international spy agency, global crises are merely opportunities for its highly trained employees to confuse, undermine, betray and royally screw each other.

items.title: DuckTales (1987)
items.desc: Scrooge McDuck, Huey, Dewey & Louie find themselves in all sorts of adventures on this animated cartoon series from Walt Disney.

items.title: The Dragon Prince
items.desc: Two human princes forge an unlikely bond with the elven assassin sent to kill them, embarking on an epic quest to bring peace to their warring lands.

items.title: Common Side Effects
items.desc: Former high school lab partners Marshall and Frances begin to unravel a conspiracy involving big pharma and the federal government to suppress knowledge of a rare mushroom that may hold the key to curing all the world’s diseases.

items.title: Star Wars: The Bad Batch
items.desc: Follow the elite and experimental Clones of the Bad Batch as they find their way in a rapidly changing galaxy in the aftermath of the Clone Wars.

items.title: Tangled: The Series
items.desc: Set between “Tangled” and “Tangled Ever After,” this animated adventure/comedy series unfolds as Rapunzel acquaints herself with her parents, her kingdom and the people of Corona.

items.title: Big Mouth
items.desc: An animated comedy from real -life best friends Nick Kroll and Andrew Goldberg explores teenage adventures in puberty.

items.title: The Boondocks
items.desc: Based on the comic strip, Huey and Riley move away from the city and out to the suburbs with their irascible grandfather. Biting socio-political commentary ensues.

items.title: Samurai Jack
items.translated_genres: Animacja, Akcja, Przygodowy, Fantasy, Fantastyczny, Thriller
items.desc: A samurai sent through time fights to return home and save the world.

items.title: Daria
items.desc: A smart & cynical girl goes through teenage life as a proud outsider in a world of mainly idiotic teens and condescending adults.

items.title: The Midnight Gospel
items.desc: Traversing trippy worlds inside his universe simulator, Clancy the space caster explores existential questions about life, death and everything in between.

items.title: Adventure Time: Fionna and Cake
items.desc: Fionna and Cake – with the help of the former Ice King, Simon Petrikov - embark on a multiverse-hopping adventure and journey of self-discovery. All the while a powerful new antagonist determined to track them down and erase them from existence, lurks in the shadows.
